connect.deleteDescription: This will permanently remove the stored VPN configuration. You will need to import it again.
connect.uninstallDescription: This removes the privileged helper daemon. You will need to reinstall it (requires admin) before connecting again.

import.title: Import Configuration
import.description: Select your WireGuard config - encrypted or plain. The file type is detected automatically.
import.decryptionPlaceholder: Enter the password provided by your admin
import.plainInfo: Plain config detected. No decryption needed - you will set a personal connection password in the next step.
import.footer: The config is stored encrypted on your device. You will never see its contents.

setupPassword.title: Set Connection Password
setupPassword.description: This password protects your VPN connection. You will enter it every time you connect.

errors.minLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.
